clips.title: The story
paras: Ghost Hair Thread is a rare, supernatural material spun by Madame Eva in Darkshire. Infused with potent occult properties, it is said to bind spiritual energies and even sew life into inanimate things. The hermit Abercrombie requests it to ward his dilapidated shack against restless ghosts.

Spun by the fortune teller Madame Eva in Darkshire, Ghost Hair Thread is far more than an ordinary tailoring supply. According to Eva, the spectral thread possesses versatile occult properties, ranging from binding malevolent spirits to stitching vitality into inanimate objects. Its ethereal nature makes it a valuable asset for rituals and wards in the cursed realm of Duskwood.
